summary_en: 160,000 shares (0.54% of S/O ex-treasury) up to ¥100M. Open-market purchase window Aug 17–Nov 13, 2026. Rationale: preserve stock currency for M&A and strengthen capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
FaithNetwork Co., Ltd. announced on August 14, 2026 that its board of directors has authorized a treasury stock repurchase program effective immediately. The company will acquire up to 160,000 ordinary shares (0.54% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥100 million through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from August 17 through November 13, 2026.

The stated rationale is twofold: (1) to preserve treasury stock as a potential currency for future M&A and capital alliances, and (2) to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation. The company notes that M&A and strategic capital partnerships are seen as key growth options alongside organic business expansion. This buyback supports the company's stated dual policy of balancing growth investment with shareholder returns.
